name: io.github.susmitbanerjee/zeitwide
title: Zeitwide
description: Business-day answers for payment rails and holiday calendars, with sources.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it, the six read tools answer at the anonymous limit (100 calls a day per IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48) with no receipt. With a Zeitwide API key (Bearer zw_live_…) calls get the key's limits and a signed receipt.

packageArguments.description: Answer from the dataset release bundled with the package: no network and no key needed.
